comparison.objective: Start and close a separating zipper, versus tune and lock a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Flexible pin/box alignment, insertion, tension management, and slider travel versus rigid hex-key alignment, collar rotation, counterholding, and force-limited locking.
comparison.success_condition: Pin fully seated and zipper closed versus two safe repeatable dynamic stops with setting retention.
comparison.reason: Flexible interlocking-chain manipulation is a different tested ability. Body and specs are absent, so zipper engagement and damage criteria are missing.
